bootstrap: Same global multinomial source multiplicities for all tasks/models/methods; recompute each task denominator, equally average five tasks per domain, subtract same-model Beam per replicate, percentile [2.5,97.5].
uncertainty_scope: Conditional on fixed saved generations; no generation-seed variance or multiplicity-adjusted significance inference.
win_tie_loss: Sign of integer task success-count difference on identical denominators; no rounding or significance threshold.
minimum: Minimum exact rational 100*(method successes-Beam successes)/task inputs across ten tasks; all exact minimizing task identifiers retained.
